clock_model.rtl_boundary: PROM-mode address and control projection is combinational; the integration-owned storage decides how to realize a qualified program request
clock_model.historical_boundary: the manufacturer high-performance algorithm applies timed CE and VPP pulses and verifies after each pulse
clock_model.limitation: The five documented Table 3-1 digital states are implemented; voltage magnitude, pulse width, overshoot, erasure, charge injection, and retention are not. Three control combinations absent from Table 3-1 are safe inactive and remain UNDEFINED_BY_DOCUMENTATION as silicon behavior

signals.name: prom_mode_i
signals.historical: P20 high, P21/P22/XTAL/STBY/NMI low, EXTAL high strap
signals.fact: digital integration indication that PROM mode is selected; active mode stops all MCU functions

signals.name: prom_program_voltage_i
signals.fact: digital indication that programming voltage is present; voltage magnitude is not modeled

signals.name: irq1_n_i
signals.fact: PROM address bit A9 in PROM mode; the active-low IRQ meaning applies only to MCU modes

signals.name: port4_i
signals.fact: remaining PROM address bits and active-low output/chip enables

signals.name: port3_i
signals.fact: byte forwarded to the integration-owned storage during the documented program state

signals.name: port3_o
signals.fact: stored byte for read/verify or FF for PROM addresses 1000-7FFF

signals.name: port3_oe_o
signals.fact: all ones only for documented read and verify states; otherwise high impedance

signals.name: prom_address_o
signals.fact: explicit fifteen-bit projection of the repurposed address pins

signals.name: prom_data_o
signals.fact: read/verify value before Port-3 output qualification

signals.name: prom_data_oe_o
signals.fact: active in Table 3-1 Read and Verify states

signals.name: prom_program_data_o
signals.fact: byte presented to the FPGA storage owner for programming

signals.name: prom_program_o
signals.historical: VPP present, CE low, OE high
signals.fact: qualified digital program request only for PROM addresses 0000-0FFF

signals.name: program_address_o
signals.fact: maps PROM address 0000-0FFF to the FPGA image address F000-FFFF

signals.name: program_read_o
signals.fact: active for read/verify only within the physical 4-KiB array

signals.name: program_data_i
signals.fact: byte supplied by integration-owned storage; copyrighted program contents are not distributed

halt_interrupt_behavior: PROM mode stops CPU and peripheral operation, suppresses the normalized external bus and execution status, makes address/control pins inputs, and uses only the documented programming interface
